body.heading: Where in the world is Armenia?
paragraphs: Armenia is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Armenia is Yerevan.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Armenia speak Armenian and Russian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Armenia is the Armenian dram.

body.heading: How big is Armenia?
paragraphs: Armenia covers about 30,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Lebanon.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Sevan is one of the largest high-mountain lakes in the world. On a peninsula stands Sevanavank monastery, with views over water that changes from blue to silver.
Geghard's chapels are carved straight into the cliff rock, while nearby Garni has a Greek-style temple above a gorge of giant basalt columns called the Symphony of Stones.
